preserved_failures.detail: Initial `mkdir` of the lane and the heredoc creation of tools/freeze.py ran as plain shell commands outside helper_guard.py (before the first guarded freeze). No Python, retrieval or hashing ran unguarded at that point.
preserved_failures.consequence: Workflow deviation recorded; frozen scientific inputs were hashed under guard immediately afterwards and match the r215 freeze.

preserved_failures.detail: A one-line lp_solve smoke test (a 2-variable LP) ran outside the guard and wrote/removed a temporary file /tmp/claude_t.lp. No scientific input involved.
preserved_failures.consequence: All subsequent lp_solve calls ran as children of guarded Python processes with temporary files inside the lane tmp/ directory.

preserved_failures.detail: First exp3 run reported fractional slack -0.52 for an LP-minimal projection whose integral packing number was 3 (contradiction). Cause: lp_solve 'Accuracy error' on 1e-17 coefficients, silently mapped to None by the wrapper.
preserved_failures.fix: lib.lp now drops |coef|<1e-13, retries with scaling/pivoting options and raises on solver failure instead of returning None. Affected run discarded (overwritten); reruns reported in discovery.md.

preserved_failures.detail: exp2 first objective d*(4-3lam)/lam saturated at lam=1 and the climber exploited noise of the quick distance estimator (quick ratio 1.04, heavy re-evaluation 1.0000000096).
preserved_failures.fix: Objective changed to rho=(d-1)/(bound-1) with lam bounded below; heavy re-evaluation of every reported optimum.

preserved_failures.detail: First exp3 'any' mode (random orthogonal-projection seeds) almost never produced ||P||<4/3; first slack objective converged to norm-1 seeds (slack 0).
preserved_failures.fix: Conjugation moves from block-averaging seeds and the loss-coefficient objective c(P) with ||P||>=1.01.

preserved_failures.detail: Bourgain 1982 publisher PDF is a 3-page image scan without a text layer; pdftotext produced 0 lines.
preserved_failures.fix: Pages rendered to PNG from the frozen copy and read visually (pages 1 and 3 read; page 2 rendered, not relied on).

preserved_failures.detail: Scripts were run as `python3 -I`, which implies -E and therefore ignores PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE; importing tools/lib.py created tools/__pycache__.
preserved_failures.fix: Bytecode directory deleted before the final manifest; manifest and verifier exclude __pycache__ explicitly. Future replays should add -B (python3 -I -B).

preserved_failures.detail: Zippin 1981/1984 (Israel J. Math., Springer), Dor 1975 (Ann. Math.) and Godefroy-Kalton-Lancien 2000 (GAFA) bodies were not retrieved. No denied route was attempted.
preserved_failures.consequence: Full quantitative subsumption check against these remains an explicit gap.
